info.name: PayFast Credit Card Transactions Transaction History API
Get transaction history for a date range

params.name: from
params.description: Start date of the range (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

params.name: offset
params.description: Pagination offset (number of records to skip)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return

items.docs: Retrieve a list of transactions for the authenticated merchant within a specified date range. Results are paginated via offset and limit.

params.name: date
params.description: The date to retrieve the daily summary for (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: offset
params.description: Pagination offset (number of records to skip)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return

items.docs: Retrieve a daily aggregated summary of transactions for a given date.

params.name: date
params.description: A date within the desired week (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: offset
params.description: Pagination offset (number of records to skip)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return

items.docs: Retrieve a weekly aggregated summary of transactions for the week containing the specified date.

params.name: offset
params.description: Pagination offset (number of records to skip)

params.name: limit

items.docs: Retrieve a monthly aggregated summary of transactions for the specified month.
